description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ServiceNotFoundException' used in the OpenMRS API to indicate that a requested service class could not be found.

classes.name: org.openmrs.api.ServiceNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a specific service class was not found within the OpenMRS API.

methods.name: ServiceNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific service class that was not found.

methods.name: getServiceClass
methods.description: Returns the class object representing the service that was not found.
